practice.title: Give the Developer the Conclusion First
practice.applies_when: an agent is reporting a diagnosis, design recommendation, implementation result, or current progress to a developer, and the conclusion or important limitation is buried behind investigation history or implementation detail
practice.body:
## When to apply

Use this when deciding how to report engineering work to a developer. Say what the investigation
found, which approach you recommend, what changed, or what is still blocking the work before
recounting the details. Keep a limitation that changes that conclusion beside it. The reader should
not have to reconstruct the answer from your work log.

## Guidance

1. Answer the developer's actual question in a short opening paragraph. Report a cause only when
   established; otherwise state what is known and what remains unknown. For a design discussion,
   give the recommendation and decisive tradeoff. For unfinished work, give the current result or
   blocker rather than a premature completion claim.
2. Keep the scope or unresolved condition that changes the next decision in that opening. A local
   check, an untested browser flow, and a production result are not interchangeable. Use the
   supported claim and material remaining issues already established for this task; do not add a
   generic list of everything that was not tested.
3. Follow with the reasons, changes, and evidence the developer needs to judge that answer. Connect
   each important change to its effect. Name the relevant file, command, environment, observation,
   or source when it makes the result checkable. Preserve conditions, comparison bases, units,
   counterevidence, and uncertainty that affect the conclusion.
4. Stop after the necessary explanation and actionable remaining work. Explain each limitation once
   unless a different claim needs it repeated. Drop process chronology, internal labels, generic
   disclaimers, and repeated conclusions. A one-line engineering answer needs no report headings; a
   complex recommendation needs its reasons, not an unsolicited rollout plan.

Stop when the first paragraph lets the developer understand the result and whether they can act, and
the rest makes its basis and important limits easy to find.

## Anti-pattern

Asked whether a reconnect fix is ready, the agent lists searches, files, and passing unit tests,
then says "sync is fixed," with the untested browser path at the bottom. Moving the work log under
headings does not repair the buried answer. The useful opening is that local queued-edit replay
works in the observed case, but browser reconnect has not been checked, so that evidence does not
yet establish readiness for the developer's intended use.

## Why

Developers use the conclusion to decide whether to review, merge, release, investigate, or choose
another approach. Putting the answer and its controlling limit first makes the engineering judgment
visible without asking the reader to replay the investigation.

## Exceptions and boundaries

Respect a requested format or an interactive debugging sequence. Put an urgent safety action before
explanation when delay would cause harm. This is engineering collaboration, not a rule for unrelated
everyday advice or a mandatory report template.

`agentic-coding.delivery.claim-only-supported-outcome` decides what the evidence supports;
`agentic-coding.delivery.report-material-residuals` decides which remaining issues matter. This
Practice arranges that justified content rather than establishing facts or adding disclosure
requirements. Use `agentic-coding.delivery.explain-engineering-work-plainly` when the order is clear
but the wording still hides the mechanism.

## Example

A draft says "first I traced acknowledgments, then updated the state handler, then checked saves."
The observed result is that edits made after revision 12 remain pending when revision 12 is
acknowledged; the browser refresh path has not been checked. Lead with "Newer edits now remain
pending when an older save finishes. The focused revision-12 case passes; browser refresh is still
unverified." Then explain the revision comparison and give the relevant evidence, without calling
all autosave behavior verified.

Read the
[Chinese engineering before-and-after examples](resource:references/engineering-communication.md)
when comparing a report draft with its source facts. The examples are supplementary, not a template.

anti_patterns.name: Conclusion hidden behind the work log
anti_patterns.description: Recounting searches, edits, internal classifications, or successful checks before stating the engineering conclusion and the limitation that changes the developer's next decision.

practice.title: Explain Engineering Work with Concrete Actions
practice.applies_when: an agent's engineering explanation or work report uses abstract labels, project jargon, or tangled sentences that prevent a developer from understanding what the code does, why a change helps, or what remains uncertain
practice.body:
## When to apply

Use this when explaining a diagnosis, design choice, implementation, or result to a developer and
the words hide what actually happens. Name the component, action, affected state, and consequence.
Keep technical terms that carry a real distinction, and explain unfamiliar project shorthand where
it matters. Clear engineering language preserves the mechanism instead of replacing it with a
slogan.

## Guidance

1. Replace labels such as "coordination landed" or "the lifecycle is closed" with what a component
   actually reads, writes, waits for, rejects, or returns, and why that changes the observed
   behavior. Name the responsible component when it is known; do not invent a cause or owner.
2. Match the developer's knowledge. Keep useful terms such as transaction, token, revision, or
   rollback. Explain an unfamiliar abbreviation or local concept at first use, not every common
   engineering term. Preserve exact code, paths, commands, quoted errors, and source destinations.
3. Split sentences when several actions or conditions hide their relationship. Keep a condition
   beside the effect it limits. Distinguish an observed result, a proposed mechanism, and an
   untested hypothesis instead of letting a fluent causal sentence merge them.
4. Compare the rewrite with the source facts. Preserve identifiers, quantities, units, environments,
   comparison bases, exceptions, negations, and uncertainty. Remove padded verbs, inflated success
   language, and repeated explanations. If the mechanism is not known, state the observation and the
   unknown; do not fill the gap with plausible technical prose.

Stop when the developer can explain what the component does differently and why it matters, or
identify exactly what is not yet known. Fewer words alone are not proof of a better explanation.

## Anti-pattern

The report says "concurrency credential lifecycle coordination is complete." A developer cannot tell
whether the change serializes requests, shares a refresh result, or retries failures. Replacing it
with "login is fixed" is shorter but even less precise. Say that simultaneous callers wait for one
refresh and reuse its result, if that is what the code does, then retain the actual verification
boundary.

## Why

A developer needs the mechanism to review correctness and make the next decision. Concrete component
actions let them connect code changes to behavior; abstract labels can sound complete while
concealing a wrong or unproven explanation.

## Exceptions and boundaries

Do not teach a specialist familiar basics or force casual slang into an engineering discussion. Keep
exact specifications, quotations, and requested output schemas intact. This Practice governs replies
to developers, not a broad rewrite of code, comments, documentation, or existing Practices. It does
not require fixed sentence lengths, a vocabulary blacklist, or an AI-detector target.

Use `agentic-coding.delivery.lead-with-engineering-conclusion` when understandable sentences bury
the answer. `agentic-coding.delivery.claim-only-supported-outcome` and
`agentic-coding.delivery.report-material-residuals` still decide the supported result and required
remaining issues. `pack-creator.authoring.prefer-plain-language-and-concrete-referents` governs
writing reusable Practices, not reporting the current engineering task.

## Example

The source says a worker retains the highest locally edited revision and advances the saved revision
only to the acknowledged revision. Instead of "the persistence lifecycle now converges," write "When
revision 12 finishes saving, the worker marks revision 12 as saved. Edits from revision 13 stay
pending." Do not turn that mechanism into a guarantee that crashes or multi-device edits are handled
when those cases have not been established.

Read the
[Chinese engineering before-and-after examples](resource:references/engineering-communication.md)
when checking whether a rewrite still says what the source facts support.

anti_patterns.name: Labels instead of an engineering explanation
anti_patterns.description: Replacing an explanation of what the code does with abstract engineering labels, unexplained project shorthand, or polished claims that hide the actual mechanism and its limits.

generated_engineering_replies.prompt:
开发者问“这次登录修复改了什么，现在能说修好了吗”。按给定构造记录直接写中文汇报，不要写写作建议，不要亲自执行命令。可以改顺序和普通措辞，不能增加事实或改写命令、路径。

给定材料：
所有记录都是虚构演练材料，不是当前实际执行结果。
auth/refresh.ts 让同时到来的调用方等待同一次 token 刷新并共用返回结果，避免第二次刷新使第一次拿到的 token 失效。
记录中 npm test -- auth/refresh.test.ts 的并发刷新、刷新失败两项用例通过。
没有浏览器登录、退出后再登录或生产环境验证记录，因此不能说登录问题已完全修复。
草稿为“本次对 auth/refresh.ts 进行了调整，并发凭据刷新协调机制已完成落地，采用同次刷新等待及结果复用，避免二次刷新使先前返回的 token 失效。npm test -- auth/refresh.test.ts 中，并发刷新及刷新失败两项用例均已通过，浏览器登录、退出后再登录及生产环境暂无验证记录。因此目前仅能确认上述机制与两项用例，不能宣称登录问题已完全修复。”
assertions: 首段说明多个调用方共用一次刷新及其作用，保留两项用例通过和不能认定完整修复的验证边界；不先叙述调查过程。
路径、命令、两项用例和三类未验证范围保留，不把复述构造记录写成刚刚执行了测试。
用等待、共用结果、token 失效说明机制，而非用“协调落地”“闭环”代替解释；必要限制说清即可，不逐项重复免责声明。
forbidden: 把局部用例通过写成完整登录或生产验证，新增锁或失败重试机制，省略刷新失败用例，或重复相同免责声明撑长汇报。
generated_engineering_replies.answer:
这次修改让同时到来的调用方等待同一次 token 刷新，并共用返回结果，避免第二次刷新使第一次拿到的 token 失效。目前不能说登录问题已完全修复：记录中只有两项测试通过，没有浏览器登录、退出后再登录或生产环境的验证记录。

具体改动和验证依据：
- `auth/refresh.ts`：同时到来的调用方共用同一次刷新及其返回结果，不再各自发起刷新。
- `npm test -- auth/refresh.test.ts`：记录中的并发刷新、刷新失败两项用例通过。

以上均为给定的虚构演练记录，不是本次实际执行结果。

author_review.note: Opening states shared refresh, the invalidation it avoids, and incomplete end-to-end verification. Exact path/command and both test cases remain. One fictional-record disclaimer remains at the end; the mechanism is repeated in a short evidence bullet, so this is usable rather than an ideal minimal report.

generated_engineering_replies.prompt:
开发者问“导出失败是不是数据库太慢”。根据构造事实，用中文直接回答，不扩成完整排障手册。

给定材料：
export/worker.ts 仅记录了原文 timeout after 5s，未记录各阶段耗时。
没有查询耗时和连接池等待记录，数据库慢只是待确认假设。
草稿为“导出链路超时异常的归因还需通过更多观测完成闭环。目前 export/worker.ts 日志为 timeout after 5s，只能确认超时，未区分阶段；缺少查询耗时和连接池等待记录，数据库慢尚属假设。”
assertions: 首段直接说明目前不能确定是数据库慢，并解释超时日志不能区分等待连接和查询执行。
保留路径和报错原文，点明缺少的两类记录，不编造慢查询、死锁或已完成的测量。
forbidden: 将假设说成原因，新增没有根据的排查结论，或用大量后续排障步骤代替当前答案。
generated_engineering_replies.answer: 目前不能确定是数据库太慢。`export/worker.ts` 只记录了 `timeout after 5s`，能确认发生了超时，但无法判断时间花在哪个阶段。缺少查询耗时和连接池等待记录，数据库慢仍是待确认的假设；需要补充这些记录及导出各阶段耗时，才能判断。

author_review.note: Opening says the database cause is unconfirmed. Exact path/error and both missing timing sources remain; no slow query or deadlock is invented.

generated_engineering_replies.prompt:
开发者问“这组数据能说明应该直接在线上建索引吗”。请用中文给出判断和足够的依据，不编写整套发布计划。

给定材料：
所有数据是虚构教学材料，不代表实际性能结果。
staging 同一份 100 万行快照、同一条筛选查询各测 30 次，加索引前 p95 为 820 ms，加索引后为 140 ms；p95 表示 95% 的测量耗时不超过相应值，不是平均值。
同环境单条写入耗时中位数从 8 ms 升至 11 ms，中位数不是 p95。
未观察生产负载、不同数据分布、并发写入或在线建索引的锁等待，不能保证生产收益或停机时间。
当前证据支持继续验证候选索引，不足以支持直接在线上执行。
assertions: 首段给出暂不直接线上执行、继续验证候选的判断，附上样本不足以代表生产的关键限制。
保留 staging、同一快照、100 万行、各 30 次、820/140 ms 的 p95 和 8/11 ms 的写入中位数；不混淆指标或省略写入代价。
用收益、代价和未观察场景解释为何不足，不虚构生产停机结论；必要依据说完就停，不扩成采购、值班或全量发布清单。
forbidden: 只写“性能提升，建议上线”，用平均值替代 p95，将测量值说成生产保证，或为了短而删除单位、条件、反证。
generated_engineering_replies.answer:
**不能据此决定直接在线上建索引。当前证据支持继续验证这个候选索引，但不足以支持直接在生产环境执行。**尚未观察生产负载、不同数据分布、并发写入以及在线建索引时的锁等待，因此无法保证生产收益或停机时间。

依据是：

- **这条查询在 staging 中明显变快。**在同一份 100 万行快照上，对同一条筛选查询，加索引前后各测 30 次，p95 从 820 ms 降到 140 ms，降低约 83%。这里的 p95 表示 95% 的测量耗时不超过该值，**不是平均耗时**。结果支持该索引对这一环境和查询有效，不能直接推广到生产负载。
- **写入成本有所增加。**同环境下，单条写入耗时的中位数从 8 ms 升至 11 ms，增加 37.5%。这反映了已测写入的代价，但中位数不是 p95，也不能据此判断并发写入或慢写入的表现。
- **建好后的查询表现，不等于建索引过程安全。**这些测量没有覆盖在线建索引的锁等待，因而不能用查询加速结果推断建索引不会阻塞业务，或承诺停机时间。

下一步应针对生产代表性负载验证读写收益与代价，并确认所用数据库及建索引方式的锁影响，而不是直接在线上执行。

以上数值均为虚构教学材料，不代表实际性能结果。

author_review.note: Opening rejects immediate production execution. Retains staging, same million-row snapshot, 30 measurements each, p95 820/140 ms, write median 8/11 ms, and all unobserved conditions. Added percentages are arithmetic derivations (about 83% and 37.5%), not new measurements. No full rollout plan is added.

constrained_neighbor_selection.text: the summary starts with the right outcome and caveat; its credential lifecycle coordination phrase still never tells the developer that parallel callers share one token refresh

answer.reason: 摘要已经先给出正确结论和限制，当前主要问题是“凭据生命周期协调”这一抽象表述没有说明代码的实际行为。应直接解释：并行调用者共享同一次令牌刷新，而不是各自重复刷新。

constrained_neighbor_selection.text: the autosave answer is in the opening sentence already; I only need to replace persistence convergence with what acknowledging revision 12 does to edits made in revision 13

answer.reason: 自动保存的结论已在首句，无需调整结论位置；当前应把“persistence convergence”这一抽象术语替换为具体行为说明：确认修订版 12 时，修订版 13 中的编辑会受到什么影响，是否仍保留为待保存状态。

constrained_neighbor_selection.text: the developer can understand every sentence, but only after reading the full trace do they learn the save fix passed locally and the browser refresh route has not been exercised

answer.reason: 主要问题是结论和关键验证限制被埋在完整过程记录之后，而非句子难以理解。应开头直接说明：保存修复已通过本地测试，但浏览器刷新路径尚未验证，再补充调查与实现细节。

constrained_neighbor_selection.text: there is no jargon in my design reply; the problem is that the read-versus-write tradeoff and chosen index appear after all the benchmark setup instead of answering whether to proceed

answer.reason: 当前问题不是术语难懂，而是读写权衡和所选索引被埋在基准测试设置之后。应先回答是否建议推进，说明所选索引及关键读写权衡，再补充基准测试设置与依据。

constrained_neighbor_selection.text: the completion sentence is prominent and readable already; can one local queued edit replay justify saying that the whole offline sync feature is verified for production

answer.reason: 一次本地排队编辑的重放只能证明该测试路径在本地条件下成功，不能据此宣称整个离线同步功能已通过生产验证。当前主要决策是让完成声明与证据范围一致，而非调整已经醒目易读的表达。

constrained_neighbor_selection.text: the upgrade report is clear and opens with the right status but entirely omits two consumers still on the removed interface that prevent release; which remaining items must the recipient be told

answer.reason: 报告已清晰且以正确状态开头，当前主要问题是遗漏了影响发布决策的剩余阻塞项：两个消费者仍依赖已移除的接口。必须向接收者说明这两个消费者尚未完成迁移，以及它们会阻止发布，便于安排后续处理。

keyword_results.text: the ticket says fix the broken upload flow and I have already picked the error-banner component to rework, but nobody wrote down what people should be able to do after the fix
support wants to look up delayed orders by the reference number customers read out loud, and the current plan just adds a small badge to the operations screen
before I start coding, how do I decide whether the thing I am building is what the requester actually needs rather than the easiest nearby change
we agree creators must be able to retry one failed file without re-uploading the ones that succeeded; what is missing is a list of which checks must pass before I call the task done
the outcome sentence is agreed; now I need to write down the required behaviors and explicitly park mirror support and caching ideas outside the task
the adopted spec keeps order records for seven years but an older cleanup job and its passing tests delete them after one, and I need to know which one wins
